title: Shadow supervisor: prepare and recover
scenario: Operator guide for a prepared schema-5 journal. The inspection capture uses the offline preparation fixture. The finish capture uses an interrupted and resumed offline AWS CLI stand-in, with an exact known launch and no SSH identity.

steps.title: Prepare once, inspect, then execute only the qualified run
steps.instruction: From the repository, use server2/deploy/shadow/provision.py prepare --state RUN --bundle BUNDLE --plan PLAN.json --source SOURCE, then inspect --state RUN --bundle BUNDLE. Prepare fixes the original 168h collection and 170h cleanup deadlines and consumes the initial grant. Keep the journal and private bundle. Do not create a replacement journal after failure.
steps.caption: Both offline commands retain the same epoch and one generation. Duplicate prepare and run without --execute return exit 2. The screenshot abbreviates local paths.
steps.expected: Retain the original state and private bundle. After required checks and launch approval, run --execute against that state and choose one new private output directory.

steps.title: Resume finish using the original output
steps.instruction: Run provision.py finish --execute --state RUN --output RESULT --aws-executable AWS --profile ACCOUNT. Use the output from the first finish. SSH identity can be supplied when the retained bucket needs missing pairs.
steps.caption: The offline replay completed with verified paired evidence, complete original sources and completed resource disposition. The output excerpt abbreviates paths and shows selected fields.
steps.expected: Use the same journal and output if the operation is interrupted. On exit 1, inspect result.json and any sources/manifest.json. At 170 hours, an incomplete export keeps the state bucket without expiry. Weather parity is evaluated separately.
